full_judgment:
4. The case of Md Saifulla as plaintiff of Title Suit No. 93 of 1985 and Defendant of Title Suit No. 222 of 1992, in brief, is that the land appertaining to SA Khatian No. 425, Plot No. 313 of Mouza Karaish, PS Kachua, District-Chandpur originally belonged to Rajani Kanta Majumder. After the death of Rajani Kanta Majumder his only son Ramesh Chandra Majumder became owner and let out the suit land to the plaintiff about 20 years ago and subsequently on 1-9-1976 he sold the suit property to the plaintiff by a registered kabala. The plaintiff possessed the same by running shop thereon. On 10-6-1979, the defendants forcibly entered into the suit land and dispossessed the plaintiff. There was a salish in which the defendants admitted their guilt and signed a Rajinama promising to deliver back possession of the suit property in favour of the plaintiff. On 31-12-1979 again the defendants forcibly entered into the suit land and dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit property. The plaintiff then filed Title Suit No. 112 of 1980 in the Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Chandpur under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act for getting back possession of the suit property. The learned Munsif (now Assistant Judge) on 30-12-1982 decreed the suit. Against the said decision the defendants preferred Civil Revision No. 109 of 1982 before the learned District Judge, Comilla which was rejected on 29-11-1983. The defendants then preferred Civil Revision No. 386 of 1983 before the High Court Division and the Rule was made absolute on 30-7-1984 with the finding that the suit is triable by the village Court. The plaintiff then filed civil petition before the Appellate Division being Civil Petition No. 351 of 1984 for leave to appeal but it was also rejected on the same finding. As the defendant claimed ownership in the disputed property this has cast cloud upon the title of the plaintiff. As such the plaintiff instituted the present suit being Title Suit No. 93 of 1985. 

 6. The case of Moulana Serajul Haque as plaintiff in Title Suit No. 222 of 1992, in short, is that the suit property originally belonged to Kali Kumar Bordhan who had no son. He had only three daughters. After his death his grandson by daughter Rabindra Chandra Majumder got the lands of the suit plot No. 312 in his share. Rabindra Chandra Majumder sold 1/2 acres of land to the plaintiff Moulana Serajul Haque, by a registered kabala dated 8-11-1984 and delivered possession. The plaintiff and other purchasers from Rabindra Chandra Majumder filed Title Suit No. 288 of 1984 in respect of .05 acres of land of the suit plot No. 312 including the suit land in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kachua. In that suit the land of suit plot No. 312 was measured by local Revenue Officer and it was found that the suit property appertains to plot No. 312. However, the said Title Suit No. 288 of 1984 was decreed on 23-2-85 declaring the title of the plaintiff in .05 acres of land of the suit plot no. 312. Subsequently on 1-6-85 the plaintiff of the Title Suit No. 288 of 1984 executed and registered a deed of partition amongst themselves in respect of the entire land of suit plot No. 312. In that partition suit plaintiff Moulana Serajul Haque was allotted the present suit land in his share. The plaintiff got his name recorded in Khariji Khatian No. 322 of 1984 and paid rent regularly. The plaintiff also got permission from the proper authority to construct two-storied building on the suit property. The defendant Md Saifullah has denied the plaintiff's right, title and interest in the suit property. Hence the plaintiff was constrained to file Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 before the Court of Assistant Judge, Kachua for declaration of title, confirmation of possession and also permanent injunction against the defendant and got a decree on 29-4-87. Against the judgment and decree the defendant Md Saifullah preferred Title Appeal No. 90 of 1987 but the appeal was ultimately dismissed and thus the judgment in Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 stands still valid. The learned Court of Appeal before which is the final court of fact, stated that the boundaries of the land which have been given in the schedule of both the suits are same. There is no dispute that the suit land of both the suits is the same. The contesting parties also have claimed that the suit land in both the suits relates to the same land. The plaintiff of Title Suit No. 222 of 1992 Moulana Serajul Haque has claimed that he previously filed Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Kachua in respect of the selfsame land against the defendant Md Saifullah and got a decree on 20-4-1987. The defendant Md Saifullah unsuccessfully contested the suit up to the appellate stage and in his presence Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 was decreed declaring plaintiff's title in the suit land. These facts are not disputed. The trial Court in the judgment of Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 stated that there was local investigation of the suit land by an Advocate Commissioner to ascertain the exact location of the suit land and the Advocate Commissioner in presence of both the plaintiff, and defendant measured the suit land and found that the suit land appertained to plot No. 312 and submitted his report accordingly. The defendant Md Saifullah did not take any step against the judgment passed by the appellate Court against him in the higher forum. So the judgment in which he was a party is very much binding upon him and the decree still stands valid. It may be stated here that in Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 on local investigation it was found that the suit land appertains to plot No. 312 and the Court found that the same belongs to Moulana Serajul Haque. It may be pointed out here that the suit land of Title Suit No. 90 of 1986 and the present suit are the same. Thus it appears that so long a valid decree passed by a competent court on contest against the defendant Md Saifullah stands the same is binding on him who is present plaintiff of Title Suit No. 93 of 1985.
